title.narrative: Social media and Conflict: Protecting peace from social media harms and enhancing digital mediation

description.narrative: The proposed action aims to minimise the harmful effects of social media on peace processes and armed conflict and increase the effectiveness of mediation. This will be achieved through policy dialogue with social media platforms, dialogue with conflict parties to forge social media peace agreements and through equipping mediators for the digital age. Focus countries for implmentation are: Yemen, Thailand and Nigeria.
